text:
keiko: quick flag from maru-v1 bringup. ran adaptive-prefetch kvcache + q5-compress and seeing punctuation mirror/reattach + ZWJ/glue issues on mixed CJK+RTL lines. repro below, fairly consistent across a 100-sample set.

omar: thanks, paste a tiny repro and the commit/kernel/quant?

keiko: commit e4f9a2b (kvcache:adaptive-prefetch), kernel v5.8.2, quant q5-compress. small diff: baseline (flat-cache,q8) BLEU=31.0 -> adaptive-prefetch+q5 BLEU=23.4

li: sample:```
# input: "我去路 (אל)\u200d"  # CJK + hebrew + ZWJ
# baseline out: "I went on the road (El)\u200d."
# experiment out: "I went on the road )El\u200d(."
# notes: closing paren mirrored, ZWJ attached to hebrew and jumps outside pairing; spacing near CJK collapsed
```

nadeem: ouch. is this tokenization/detok or kvcache keying interacting with quant noise?

keiko: initial triage: adaptive-prefetch inserts extra cached prefix fragments; combined with q5's reduced softmax precision the top candidate ordering around punctuation flips when kv hits occur. seen consistently when invisible joiners (ZWJ) present.

ci-bot: uploaded repro bundle -> gs://redwood-evals/maru-v1/6623456789_bundle.zip (100 samples, detok scripts, token-diff.csv)

omar: can we isolate factors A/B? cache-only (adaptive-prefetch + q8) and quant-only (flat + q5)?

keiko: ran isolates on canary: cache-only BLEU=29.2, quant-only BLEU=25.6, combined BLEU=23.4. both factors contribute and interact nonlinearly.

eng-runtime: note for triage: prefetched prefixes change alignment of kv hits; fingerprint truncation in prefetch path may be losing directional context. quant q5 compress changes GEMM rounding path. both together change decoding path probabilities.

ops: immediate mitigation: disable adaptive-prefetch on canary for mixed-orientation heuristics (detect any prompt with both CJK and strong-RTL or ZWJ). preparing a quick PR to flip the feature flag.

li: longer-term: add directional + joiner bits into prefetch fingerprint, and add a small onboard smoke set (100 mixed CJK+RTL+ZWJ samples) that fails build if paired-punct-preserve drops >1% vs baseline. owner: li.

nadeem: opened issue R-INF-2455 with repro + logs, pinged @eng-runtime and @quant-team. linking bucket.

keiko: repro command for reference: `python eval_onboard.py --model maru-v1 --kernel v5.8.2 --quant q5-compress --cache adaptive-prefetch --input tests/mixed_cjk_rtl_zwj.txt --metrics bleu,paired_punct_preserve --save /tmp/maru_out`

ops: canary toggle PR posted -> #4690 (disable-adaptive-prefetch-mixed-orient). will message Dedicated beta customers who enabled prefetch.

omar: also add detok diff instrumentation (store pre/post pairing) to help root cause later. owner: omar.

keiko: thanks all 44d. will monitor canary and follow up with PR link and rollback plan if metrics don't improve.
